objective: Proof: for every knot K in S3, (a) every homomorphism from the knot group to S4 sending the meridian to a transposition sends the preferred longitude to 1, because the representation lifts through GL(2,3) -> PGL(2,3) = S4 (the lifting obstruction lies in H^2 of the knot group with F2 coefficients, which vanishes) and lifts of a transposition and of the commuting double transposition anticommute; (b) for every homomorphism phi to S3 sending meridians to transpositions, the image of the twisted lifting cohomology H^1(X; V_phi) in H^1(boundary; V_phi) is half-dimensional (half-lives-half-dies, V_phi the self-dual 2-dimensional module), so with (a) the lifts of phi with a fixed transposition meridian and with a fixed 4-cycle meridian are equinumerous, and all 4-cycle lifts of phi share one longitude. Hence the conjugation quandles of transpositions and 4-cycles of S4 (the connected quandles C[6,1] and C[6,2]) give equal colouring counts for every knot, as conjectured by Clark, Elhamdadi, Hou, Saito and Yeatman (2013), and every 3-colourable knot has a non-trivial C[6,2] colouring (Carter, Oshiro and Saito 2009). Standard-library checks with a virtual-knot control.
status: Proved by CLOSED-H1-20261025-001B-P001: for every knot, transposition S4 colourings have trivial longitude (lift through GL(2,3), lifts of a transposition and its commuting double transposition anticommute, H^2 of the knot group vanishes); over every S3 colouring the twisted lifting cohomology has a one-dimensional boundary image (half-lives-half-dies with the self-dual module V4), so the lifts with a fixed transposition meridian and with a fixed 4-cycle meridian are equinumerous and the 4-cycle lifts share one longitude; hence the connected quandles C[6,1] and C[6,2] colour every knot equally (Clark-Elhamdadi-Hou-Saito-Yeatman 2013 conjecture for this pair) and 3-colourable knots are non-trivially C[6,2]-colourable (Carter-Oshiro-Saito 2009); a virtual knot shows the 3-manifold input is needed.
title: The two connected quandles of order 6 colour every knot equally
